{{Top|leg}}
A '''micro fusion reactor''' was a miniaturized [[power fusion generator]]. It was capable of producing the power of a medium power generator while being only the size of a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]], allowing individuals to carry and use it in the field. [[Lardanis Survival Systems]] manufactured the [[MFCR-200 Power Generator]].
